}}At some point between [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]] and [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], a '''battle''' of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] took place in the [[Telos system/Legends|Telos system]].
